instagram.caption:
$7.9 million just went into teaching AI what "good taste" actually looks like. 🎨

The team behind Design Arena raised the cash to inject human aesthetic judgment into models — so when you ask for a logo or a layout, it doesn't come back looking like a generic template. They're training it to *feel* style, not just analyze pixels.

For you, that means the next AI draft could actually match your brand's tone — less robotic walls of text, more visuals that don't make you cringe. 🖌️

Run your next brief through their taste filter. Compare it to your gut call. Whose judgment wins on a real post this week? 🤔
